oil.when: 2018–2019 with the display between the gauges (Settings > Maintenance > Oil and Filter)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Stop the car, set the parking brake and turn the ignition to ON.
Use the arrow switches on the left of the steering wheel to reach Settings in the display between the gauges, then press ENTER.
Select Maintenance, then Oil and Filter, pressing ENTER each time.
Choose the reset option to restart the reminder. Use the back switch to leave the menu.
oil.note: This reminder is a distance you set yourself, not an oil-life sensor. Match it to the interval in your maintenance schedule. Checked in the 2018 and 2019 owner's manuals.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light does not go out right after you add air; it goes out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2018 and 2019 owner's manuals.
